title: Departing Google chief scientist Jeff Dean has been in talks for a $10 billion valuation for his new AI startup
excerpt: The legendary Google engineer has been in discussions for a $1 billion funding round in his new AI startup, Discovery Loop.
content_html:
Exclusive

By Katie Roof

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

and Ben Bergman

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Jeff Dean spent 27 years helping build Google. Now, investors could be betting $1 billion that he can build the next big thing in AI outside it.

The legendary Google engineer has been in discussions for $1 billion in financing at a valuation of around $10 billion for his new AI startup, Discovery Loop, people familiar with the matter told Business Insider.

Discovery Loop has been one of the most talked-about startups in Silicon Valley over the past week, after Dean, regarded at Google as a legend, announced his departure.

Details of the round could change. A representative for Dean declined to comment.

While he has not publicly shared fundraising details, Dean has been open about the goal of the startup, Discovery Loop, describing it on X as a public benefit corporation "whose mission is to automate machine learning, science, and engineering to accelerate discoveries and progress."

The company hopes to tackle some of science and engineering's hardest problems through the "parallel execution of thousands of experiments."

A Discovery Loop press release from August 5 said that the company's initial funding round is being led by Radical Ventures and Khosla Ventures, with participation from Lightspeed, Kleiner Perkins, and Doerr Capital. Alphabet is a founding investor and cloud partner, according to Google CEO Sundar Pichai.

Discovery Loop's other founders bring decades of experience building some of Google's most important products.

Sanjay Ghemawat, a longtime collaborator of Dean who joined Google in 1999, helped develop foundational distributed-computing technologies. Quoc Le, a founding member of Google Brain, became a prominent researcher in deep learning and large-scale neural networks, contributing to advances in language models and other foundation models. Oriol Vinyals, meanwhile, was a leading researcher at Google DeepMind whose work spans sequence modeling and reinforcement learning.

Dean shared a pitch deck on X that one former Google product leader called "one of the most stacked pitch decks ever made."

One slide lists products the founding team worked on, including Google Search, Ads, Gemini, and Gmail. Another slide focuses on academic credentials, showing Google Scholar rankings placing Dean, Le, and Vinyals among the most highly cited AI researchers.

Discovery Loop's team is the latest example of Google talent leaving the company to raise huge sums for new AI startups.

Former DeepMind researcher David Silver raised $1.1 billion this year at a $5.1 billion valuation for Ineffable Intelligence, his new lab focused on building AI that learns from experience, while former DeepMind researchers Misha Laskin and Ioannis Antonoglou reportedly raised at a $25 billion pre-money valuation for Reflection AI.

Periodic Labs, cofounded by former Google Brain researcher Ekin Dogus Cubuk and former OpenAI researcher Liam Fedus, has raised hundreds of millions, while Sakana AI, cofounded by former Google researchers Llion Jones and David Ha, was valued at $2.65 billion last year.

作者：Katie Roof 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。 和 Ben Bergman 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

杰夫·迪恩 (Jeff Dean) 花了 27 年时间帮助创建 Google。 现在，投资者可能会押注 10 亿美元，押注他可以在人工智能领域之外打造下一个重大产品。

知情人士告诉 Business Insider，这位传奇的谷歌工程师一直在讨论为他的新人工智能初创公司 Discovery Loop 提供 10 亿美元的融资，估值约为 100 亿美元。

在被谷歌视为传奇人物的 Dean 宣布离职后，Discovery Loop 成为过去一周硅谷最受关注的初创公司之一。

本轮的细节可能会发生变化。 迪恩的代表拒绝发表评论。

虽然 Dean 没有公开分享筹款细节，但他对这家初创公司 Discovery Loop 的目标持开放态度，在 X 上将其描述为一家公益公司，“其使命是实现机器学习、科学和工程自动化，以加速发现和进步。”

该公司希望通过“并行执行数千个实验”来解决一些科学和工程领域最困难的问题。

Discovery Loop 8 月 5 日发布的新闻稿称，该公司的首轮融资由 Radical Ventures 和 Khosla Ventures 领投，Lightspeed、Kleiner Perkins 和 Doerr Capital 参与其中。 谷歌首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊 (Sundar Pichai) 表示，Alphabet 是创始投资者和云合作伙伴。

Discovery Loop 的其他创始人带来了数十年构建 Google 一些最重要产品的经验。

Sanjay Ghemawat 是 Dean 的长期合作者，于 1999 年加入 Google，帮助开发了基础分布式计算技术。 Quoc Le 是 Google Brain 的创始成员，成为深度学习和大规模神经网络领域的杰出研究员，为语言模型和其他基础模型的进步做出了贡献。 与此同时，Oriol Vinyals 是 Google DeepMind 的首席研究员，其工作涵盖序列建模和强化学习。

Dean 在 X 上分享了一份宣传材料，一位前 Google 产品负责人称其为“有史以来最丰富的宣传材料之一”。

一张幻灯片列出了创始团队开发的产品，包括 Google 搜索、广告、Gemini 和 Gmail。 另一张幻灯片重点关注学术资历，显示谷歌学术排名，Dean、Le 和 Vinyals 跻身被引用率最高的人工智能研究人员之列。

Discovery Loop 的团队是谷歌人才离开公司为新的人工智能初创公司筹集巨额资金的最新例子。

前 DeepMind 研究员 David Silver 今年以 51 亿美元的估值为 Ineffable Intelligence 筹集了 11 亿美元，他的新实验室专注于构建从经验中学习的人工智能，而前 DeepMind 研究员 Misha Laskin 和 Ioannis Antonoglou 据报道为 Reflection AI 筹集了 250 亿美元的投前估值。

由前谷歌大脑研究员 Ekin Dogus Cubuk 和前 OpenAI 研究员 Liam Fedus 共同创立的 periodic Labs 已筹集数亿美元，而由前谷歌研究员 Llion Jones 和 David Ha 共同创立的 Sakana AI 去年估值为 26.5 亿美元。

以下是关于我的更多信息：此前，我是 LAist/南加州公共广播电台的高级记者，报道商业和经济。 我还为《纽约时报》和《哥伦比亚新​​闻评论》撰稿，并曾在《泰晤士报》担任报道实习生。 我的职业生涯始于 NPR 早间版的制片人，还为公共电视制作了屡获殊荣的纪录片。 2017-2018 学年，我作为奈特-白芝浩研究员在哥伦比亚商学院度过。 之后，我负责监督 The Journal 的开发，这是由《华尔街日报》和 Gimlet Media 制作的每日播客。我来自西雅图，以优异的成绩毕业于洛杉矶西方学院，获得政治学学位。在空闲时间，我喜欢滑雪、网球和扑克。 我参加了 2024 年世界扑克系列赛主赛事，但遗憾的是没有获胜。
